name: Discovery Marathon 2026
short_description: Discovery Marathon 2026 is a full marathon and multi-distance race set for September 20, 2026, at City Di Mare, Cebu City, Philippines.
ai_summary: Discovery Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for September 20, 2026, in Cebu City, Philippines, based at City Di Mare, South Road Properties. Organized by KNC, the event offers four distance options: 42.195 km (full marathon), 21.1 km, 12 km, and 6 km. Registration has not yet been announced.

core_facts.venue: City Di Mare, South Road Properties, Cebu City

pros: Multiple distance options (42.195 km, 21.1 km, 12 km, 6 km) suit a range of runner levels
Held at a scenic South Road Properties venue in Cebu City
Organized by KNC, giving the event a clear organizing body
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

research_highlights: Discovery Marathon 2026 will be held on September 20, 2026 at City di Mare, SRP, Cebu City, with 6KM, 12KM, 21KM and 42KM categories.
The event is organized by KNC Entertainment Production, with online registration handled via their myruntime.com platform.

Race inclusions for the 2025 edition (same organizer/venue) included an event shirt, finisher's medal, finisher's jacket towel for the full marathon, hydration stations, post-race meals and raffle entries — likely to carry over to 2026.

faqs.question: When is the Discovery Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Discovery Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. This date applies to the full event, which includes the full marathon distance as well as the shorter companion distances offered on race day in Cebu City, Philippines.

faqs.question: Where is the Discovery Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at City Di Mare, located within South Road Properties in Cebu City, Philippines. This venue serves as the base for the event, which is organized by KNC and offers several distance categories for participants.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Discovery Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distances: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 12 km race, and a 6 km race. This range allows participants of varying experience levels to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Discovery Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Discovery Marathon 2026 has not yet been announced. Details on sign-up dates, fees, and procedures are not currently available, so prospective participants should check back later for updates from the organizer, KNC.
